title: Idle's Coins
description: Idle's Coins is a simple mod that adds Coins and a Machine to convert these Coins into Minecraft.
body:
**Idle's Coins** is a simple mod that adds Coins and a Machine to convert these Coins into Minecraft.
It's very useful in any roleplay server or story driven one as a currency.

**Note: These coins are purely meant as a roleplay-based currency, so none of them can be obtained outside of creative mode.**

You can use this mod in your modpack without any problems.
